requirements.requirement_summary: Synchronize Sales Navigator/LinkedIn lead data with HubSpot CRM, including list transfer, duplicate/status handling, profile link handling, and related lead-management visibility questions.

proposed_first_milestone_deliverables: Set up a LinkedIn list in Sales Navigator
Transfer the LinkedIn list smoothly to HubSpot
client_questions: Whether silent leads moved from CRM segments into a follow-up segment can be exported seamlessly to MeetAlfred without manually cleaning earlier campaigns
Whether silent leads can be placed into follow-up campaigns without manual action in MeetAlfred
Whether existing CRM records are detected only after export via duplicate alert or directly on the LinkedIn profile
Whether LinkedIn profile links are included and Sales Navigator links excluded when data moves from Sales Navigator to the CRM
What is included in the Lead Management System
Whether each lead's email and LinkedIn chat history will be visible in HubSpot
attributes.crm_synchronization_availability: Cannot proceed under Sales Navigator Advanced; limited to Advance Plus

scope.affected_work: CRM synchronization and related lead/list transfer workflow

ambiguity.description: The visible history shows a proposal and follow-up discussion, but no explicit client acceptance of the milestone terms.
The client asked what it includes, but no answer is visible.

execution.result: Freelancer tried CRM synchronization under Advanced, but it was not allowed.
